name: Herb Wallerstein
bio: Herb Wallerstein was an American television director and producer known for his work on popular TV series. Born in New York City, he directed episodes for shows like Star Trek (1966–1969), The Brady Bunch (1969–1974), and The Six Million Dollar Man (1974–1978). Wallerstein's direction contributed to the success of these series, and his ability to handle diverse genres made him a respected figure in television production.
place: New York City, New York, USA
